description: A link for the user to make a background the library does not have, in AniBG Studio. The user opens the link, and making a picture costs them credits (or one of two free previews a day). Use it when this connection has no API key (generate_background paints directly when it has one). Either describe a new picture with prompt (with time and aspect), or start from a library scene with scene (with time and want: rain, snow, a 9:16 phone crop or 4k). Example: {"prompt": "quiet train platform in the countryside", "time": "sunset"} or {"scene": "bg-014", "want": "snow"}

prompt.description: What the picture shows, in plain words. Use this or scene.

scene.description: A library scene id, like bg-014, to remake. Use this or prompt.

name: studio_link
title: Studio link for the user
